spans.s: शौद्धोदनिः [śauddhōdaniḥ], An epithet of Buddha, son of शुद्धोदन.
Relating to a Śūdra or his tribe; शौद्राणि कर्माणि च ब्राह्मणः सन्
.-द्रः The son of a man of any of the first three castes by a Śūdra woman; see
सौदर्य [saudarya], n. Brotherhood. -a. Brotherly or sisterly.
सौदामनी [saudāmanī] सौदामिनी [saudāminī] सौदाम्नी [saudāmnī], सौदामिनी सौदाम्नी 1 Lightning; सौदामन्या कनकनिकषस्निग्धया दर्शयोर्वीम्
A kind of lightning (forked one); काञ्चनाभं नभश्चक्रे विद्युत्सौदामिनी यथा

सौदायिक [saudāyika], a. (-की f.) Whatever is given to a woman at her marriage by her parents, or a relative in general, which becomes her own property; मातृपित्रा- दिभिर्दत्तं धनं सौदायिकं स्मृतम् Śukra.4.814. -कम् A nuptial present so made.
